title: Fourier Series
description: Any repeating signal is a sum of pure tones. Fourier said so in 1807, and nobody believed him. Unlocks the Fourier Series.

puzzle.goal: A signal jumps between +1 and −1 every half period. Write the size A of its n-th odd harmonic.
puzzle.name: Square wave
puzzle.method: Multiply the signal by sin(nx) and average: only odd n survive, each 4/(πn) as big.
